title: Discriminated unions instead of optional fields
context: Type safety was better served by making invalid states unrepresentable.
decision: Use discriminated unions with internal tags (e.g., ToolStatus, BootStatus). Narrow on status.state to ensure right fields exist. Reject structs where half the fields are |undefined.
consequences: Type system prevents presence of fields that should only exist in certain states. Refactoring is safer; compilers catch misuse.
